jobs.title: Campus Police Officer II: Patrol, Protect & Serve
jobs.description: A public university in Texas is seeking a Police Officer II to ensure safety on campus. Responsibilities include preventive patrol, investigating criminal activities, and enforcing laws. Candidates should be at least 20.5 years old, possess a high school diploma or GED, and have an active peace officer license. The role requires good judgment and effective communication skills. The position involves rotating shifts, providing law enforcement, and maintaining order in the community.
